external_sources.title: Dynamic time series momentum of cryptocurrencies
external_sources.claim: Crypto return persistence is time-varying across intraday/interday frequencies.

external_sources.title: Time-series momentum and market timing in Bitcoin
external_sources.claim: Reported Bitcoin tests favor slower momentum signals over fast signals where short-horizon noise can cause overreaction.

external_sources.title: The Science and Practice of Trend-Following Systems
external_sources.claim: Trend-following economics depend on persistence/low-frequency autocorrelation and trading costs.

external_sources.title: Following a Trend with an Exponential Moving Average: Analytical Results for a Gaussian Model
external_sources.claim: Trend-following timescale and turnover interact with autocorrelation and transaction costs.

external_sources.title: Price Momentum and Trading Volume
external_sources.claim: Trading volume contains information about momentum magnitude and persistence.

external_sources.title: Stop Distance, Exit Methodology, and Signal Preservation in Intraday Value Area Breakouts
external_sources.claim: Unfiltered breakout continuation can be economically weak; invalidation/exit design requires direct testing.

external_sources.title: Market Regime Techniques for Systematic Traders
external_sources.claim: Regime filters can avoid bad conditions, while threshold micro-optimization increases whipsaw/curve-fit risk.

external_sources.title: Eric Crittenden on systematic trend following
external_sources.claim: Trend systems are vulnerable to fast reversals/whipsaw; simple durable processes are preferred over constant tinkering.

external_sources.title: Systematic Trend-Following with Adaptive Portfolio Construction: Enhancing Risk-Adjusted Alpha in Cryptocurrency Markets
external_sources.claim: Volatility-aware trailing exits are a testable crypto trend hypothesis; preprint evidence only.

fingerprint.reason: Gross expectancy is negative before the verified 14bps cost, so fee reduction is not a causal rescue.

top3_axes.mechanism: Allow Keltner breakout intent only when closed-bar entry-time persistence/efficiency indicates sustained directional structure.
top3_axes.falsification: Fresh-boundary candidate fails to improve gross expectancy and PF versus frozen baseline/control or retention/sample gate fails.

top3_axes.mechanism: Require one preregistered relative-volume/participation confirmation at entry.
top3_axes.falsification: Conditioned breakouts do not beat frozen participation control out of sample or only delete losses destructively.

top3_axes.mechanism: Keep entry unchanged; add one fixed preregistered invalidation if price re-enters the channel/loses breakout structure before follow-through.
top3_axes.falsification: Winner truncation/payoff deterioration outweighs loss/DD improvement in fresh replay.

fingerprint.reason: Observed trades are gross-negative before costs; current evidence points to timing/noise failure rather than fee-only failure.

top3_axes.mechanism: Replace only trend signal speed with one preregistered slower-timescale variant; no parameter grid.
top3_axes.falsification: Fresh slower specification fails to beat frozen baseline on gross/net expectancy and PF or materially worsens DD/retention.

top3_axes.mechanism: Keep trend signal unchanged; trade only when entry-time persistence indicates a genuine low-frequency directional state.
top3_axes.falsification: OOS/control shows no incremental edge after conditioning or retention/sample gate fails.

top3_axes.mechanism: Keep entry/signal unchanged; test one volatility-scaled trailing exit to preserve trends while reducing reversal giveback.
top3_axes.falsification: Fresh OOS shows winner truncation/payoff compression or no net/DD improvement after costs.
